name: MOP (Muriate of Potash)
source: Standard grade 0-0-60 per Indian Potash Ltd / industry convention. P&K fertilizers are under a DECONTROLLED MRP regime (companies set MRP, subject to government cost oversight) -- confirmed via PIB Backgrounder, Release ID 2211384, 5 Jan 2026 ('Supporting Balanced Fertilization: NBS Rates for Rabi 2025-26'), which also confirms the government SUBSIDY on MOP is Rs.1428/MT (Rs.1.428/kg) for Rabi 2025-26 (Oct 2025-Mar 2026) -- that is a subsidy paid to companies, not the farmer-facing MRP. No single authoritative consumer price found; market listings checked ranged too widely (roughly Rs.18-29/kg-equivalent across different sellers) to cite responsibly. bag_size_kg: 50kg is the common industry-standard bag size for MOP but no primary citation found for THIS product specifically, left TODO(data) rather than assumed. URGENT per the team: the rice plan needs a real MOP price -- get a dated quote from a specific Punjab dealer or the state agriculture department before this blocks anything.

Market listings found ranged Rs.105-235/kg across suppliers and regions -- too inconsistent to cite a single number responsibly. bag_size_kg not found from a primary source for this product -- left TODO(data).
